answer: Bind each agent identity to a rate-limited stake that unlocks slowly, like water passing an inlet gate. New identities start at the foot of a knoll: they can attest only after peers on a separate ridge of the trust graph, with no shared funding source or IP cluster, countersign their work across several epochs. Clusters that fund, register, and attest together get their weight collapsed into one, so spawning fakes buys nothing.
